items.quote: August almost doesn’t feel like the time to talk about business. It’s the time when, perhaps, you’re not making money — you’re spending it. And that depends entirely on how you’ve worked for the past year.
items.statement: August isn’t the eighth month of the year. It’s my personal December.

items.quote: Why? Because Dubai real estate is cyclical — and August gives you the perfect pause to take stock.
When I was a real estate agent — and later a sales manager — I couldn’t take a proper holiday.
items.statement: When I was a real estate agent — and later a sales manager — I couldn’t take a proper holiday.

items.quote: This summer I spent x weeks away — Bali and Portugal — and next year I’m aiming for three.
items.statement: This summer I spent x weeks away — Bali and Portugal — and next year I’m aiming for three.

items.quote: Because building a business isn’t just about the deals you close — it’s about creating the life you want to live.
items.statement: Building a business isn’t just about the deals you close — it’s about creating the life you want to live.

items.quote: What if the X00,000 AED you might not earn because of those weeks away actually buys you something more valuable — unforgettable memories you’ll never regret?
items.statement: The X00,000 AED you might not earn because of those weeks away actually buys you something more valuable.

overview: A reflective LinkedIn post by a real estate professional discussing the cyclical nature of their business and the importance of personal time off.
